passage.label: O Prophet when divorce women divorce them commencement waiting period keep count fear Allah your Lord; do not turn out houses nor leave unless clear immorality; those limits Allah whoever transgresses wronged himself; know not perhaps Allah bring about after that different matter; when fulfilled term retain acceptable terms or part acceptable terms; bring witness two just men establish testimony acceptance Allah; instructed whoever believe Allah Last Day; whoever fears Allah make way out; provide where not expect; relies upon Allah sufficient Him; indeed Allah accomplish purpose set everything decreed extent; those no longer expect menstruation doubt period three months also those not menstruated; pregnant term until give birth; whoever fears Allah make matter ease; command Allah sent down you; whoever fears Allah remove misdeeds make great reward; lodge them section dwell means do not harm oppress; if pregnant spend until give birth; if breastfeed give payment confer acceptable way; if discord another woman breastfeed father; man wealth spend wealth provision restricted spend what Allah given; Allah does not charge soul except what given; Allah bring about after hardship ease

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِذَا طَلَّقۡتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحۡصُواْ ٱلۡعِدَّةَۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمۡۖ لَا تُخۡرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّ وَلَا يَخۡرُجۡنَ إِلَّآ أَن يَأۡتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةٖ مُّبَيِّنَةٖۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ ظَلَمَ نَفۡسَهُۥۚ لَا تَدۡرِي لَعَلَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحۡدِثُ بَعۡدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرٗا

فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٖ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجٗا
وَيَرۡزُقۡهُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَحۡتَسِبُۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسۡبُهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمۡرِهِۦۚ قَدۡ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدۡرٗا

وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي يَئِسۡنَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمۡ إِنِ ٱرۡتَبۡتُمۡ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشۡهُرٖ وَٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي لَمۡ يَحِضۡنَۚ وَأُوْلَٰتُ ٱلۡأَحۡمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مِنۡ أَمۡرِهِۦ يُسۡرٗا
ذَٰلِكَ أَمۡرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيۡكُمۡۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعۡظِمۡ لَهُۥٓ أَجۡرًا

أَسۡكِنُوهُنَّ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجۡدِكُمۡ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُوْلَٰتِ حَمۡلٖ فَأَنفِقُواْ عَلَيۡهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعۡنَ حَمۡلَهُنَّۚ فَإِنۡ أَرۡضَعۡنَ لَكُمۡ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَأۡتَمِرُواْ بَيۡنَكُم بِمَعۡرُوفٖۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرۡتُمۡ فَسَتُرۡضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخۡرَىٰ

لِيُنفِقۡ ذُو سَعَةٖ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقُهُۥ فَلۡيُنفِقۡ مِمَّآ ءَاتَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا مَآ ءَاتَىٰهَاۚ سَيَجۡعَلُ ٱللَّهُ بَعۡدَ عُسۡرٖ يُسۡرٗا

mainSubject.label: Divorce commanded at the commencement of the waiting period with its count maintained under taqwa; wives not expelled from their homes nor leaving themselves unless committing clear immorality, these being Allah's limits whose transgression is self-wronging since He may yet bring a new matter; retention or separation at term's end on acceptable terms witnessed by two just men as instruction for believers in Allah and the Last Day; whoever fears Allah receiving a way out and provision from unexpected sources, with reliance on Him sufficing since He accomplishes His purpose having set every matter's extent; post-menopausal and non-menstruating women assigned three months while pregnancy lasts until delivery, with ease promised to the God-fearing; this named Allah's sent-down command removing misdeeds and magnifying reward; lodging within means without oppressive harm, spending on pregnant women until delivery, nursing compensation settled amicably or delegated to another nurse if discord arises; the wealthy spending from wealth and the restricted from what Allah gave, since He charges no soul beyond its portion and brings ease after hardship

commandsAndProhibitions.description: When you divorce women, divorce them for the commencement of their waiting period and keep count of it.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Do not turn them out of their houses, nor should they leave during that period unless they commit clear immorality.

commandsAndProhibitions.excerpt: فَإِذَا بَلَغۡنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمۡسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٍ أَوۡ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعۡرُوفٖ وَأَشۡهِدُواْ ذَوَيۡ عَدۡلٖ مِّنكُمۡ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجۡعَل لَّهُۥ مَخۡرَجٗا
commandsAndProhibitions.description: When they have nearly fulfilled their term, either retain them on acceptable terms or part with them on acceptable terms, and bring two just witnesses.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Lodge them in a section of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them to oppress them.

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted let him spend from what Allah has given him.
